svg.title: How a WebMCP tool call works
svg.desc: Four steps: the page registers tools, the agent discovers them, the user or browser approves a call, the page executes and updates the UI.

text.font-family: 'Noto Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: A tool call on a live page
